driver.invalid_command_domain: $80-$EF has no complete pointer directory and must not be enumerated as tracks
driver.channel_pointer_order: header pointers follow mask bits low-to-high: noise, triangle, pulse-2, pulse-1

sequence_regions.label: 命令 $01-$0C 的 BGM 音序 bank
命令 $0D-$1A 的 BGM 音序区（止于 PRG $01DAD0）
sequence_regions.notes: PRG $01DAD0 起依次是场景调色板、剧情配置、对齐与高段场景指针；不得沿旧的 $01DE20 粗边界吞入场景数据。

sequence_regions.label: 命令 $1B-$6F 直接入口可达的音效音序区
sequence_regions.notes: sequence_graph 已遍历所有已确认 call/jump 可达子流；PRG $01F98A 起已确认是文本并作为硬停止边界，未整 bank 误标为音频。

sequence_regions.label: Bank $1D 本地音序保守窗口（首可达入口 $B710）
sequence_regions.notes: $B705 是 voice 10-15 共用的保留 $FF 哨兵，$B706-$B70F 为填充；首个实际可达本地音序入口是 $B710。解码窗口仍从 $B705 开始以硬边界保护。

period_table.index_algorithm: 8-bit (transpose + note nibble), then ASL A; byte offset wraps at 0x100
period_table.fine_offset_algorithm: signed 8-bit value is added to the little-endian timer, then high is masked to 3 bits

noise.mode: long LFSR because driver writes note nibble with bit 7 clear

tempo.tempo_tick_condition: one tick when the 16-bit addition carries out

dpcm.delta_rule: bit 1 adds 2 and bit 0 subtracts 2; NES DMC output saturates at 0..127

playback.fidelity_boundary: sequence timing, timer lookup, raw APU frames, voice programs and DPCM bytes are exact; Web Audio resampling and analogue NES mixer characteristics are not bit-exact hardware output
